patch_description: Crossover combining: (1) the current program's fast Adam+polish core (best score 0.84, 0.31s), (2) the richer seed portfolio from the 0.81 program (golden-ratio low-discrepancy seed + repulsion seeds + jittered lattices), and (3) the incremental bottleneck polish that only recomputes cross products for triplets containing the moved point (~90 of 165 rows), and (4) the gradient-based adaptive-threshold polish from the 0.53 program as a final refinement pass. The multi-seed portfolio increases the chance of escaping poor local optima (main driver of quality), while incremental polish keeps eval time low. Determinism is preserved via fixed seeds, and the feasible fallback is retained.
